channel.title: Asia News
channel.description: Read the latest stock market news and analysis on Asia Pacific in regions from Japan, China, Singapore, Australia, to New Zealand. Find business; finance; economy, stocks, and global economy news on CNBC's Asia Pacific page.

item.title: Why China is importing a record amount of gold — and what it means for prices
item.description: Beijing’s push to diversify away from the dollar and Chinese households’ search for a safe place to put their savings has fueled China’s record gold buying.

item.title: Why Japan's 7-Eleven store closures in India don’t signal an exit
item.description: 7-Eleven store closures point to a reset of its operations in India, not to an exit.

item.title: China and Europe agree to cut Chinese hybrid vehicle exports by half
item.description: Europe's trade chief Maroš Sefčovič cast the two days of talks with China's Commerce Minister Wang Wentao in Beijing as a positive first step.
